title: docs(spec): package-registry enableOnInstall doc block names the import that makes the cycle
body:
Fixes #19748
Clause-②: no

One line in the `enableOnInstall` doc block of `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-registry.zod.ts` ("Why the reference is documentary") said `PackageInstallRequestSchema` "is built from `ManifestSchema` and `InstalledPackageSchema`, both declared here". Two parts of that were false:

- `ManifestSchema` is declared in `kernel/manifest.zod.ts` and only imported here (`:4`). It is dropped from the sentence because it plays no part in the cycle.
- `PackageInstallRequestSchema`'s own body does not read `InstalledPackageSchema` (it reads `ManifestSchema` and `ArtifactReferenceSchema`). The cycle is at module level: `src/api/package-api.zod.ts` imports `InstalledPackageSchema` from this file (`:5`) for `AssembledInstalledPackageSchema`, `InstalledPackageAtEitherStageSchema` and `PackageInstallResponseSchema`. The line now names that import.

The directive against `PackageInstallRequestSchema.shape.enableOnInstall` and the rest of the block are unchanged (diff: 1 line in the source, plus the changeset).

## Import-graph reading (head 99c17b3cbb)

Method: TypeScript AST over `packages/spec/src`. An edge is an `import` / `export ... from` that survives type erasure (`import type` and all-type-only specifier lists are dropped). A BFS looks for a path.

- `api/package-api.zod.ts` to `kernel/package-registry.zod.ts`: a direct edge (`:5`). This is the edge that makes the cycle.
- `package-api.zod.ts` has ten direct runtime imports. None of the other nine reaches `package-registry.zod.ts`, and `kernel/manifest.zod.ts` is one of them: its runtime closure is 33 files at depth 4, with no path back.
- Controls, to show the instrument finds paths that exist: `manifest.zod.ts` to `ui/app.zod.ts` and to its depth-4 files, and `stack.zod.ts` to `kernel/manifest.zod.ts`, are all reached.

## Changeset

`@objectstack/spec` patch. `src/**/*.zod.ts` is in the package's `files[]`. After the build, the comment is also in `dist/{api,kernel}/index.{js,mjs}` and the browser copies: the old sentence is in 0 built files and the new line is in 8.

## Not in this PR

`.changeset/18605-enable-on-install-one-authority.md:19` repeats the sentence, including the claim that the schema is built from `InstalledPackageSchema`. That file belongs to #19735's scope, and #19735 is not addressed here.
